Responsibilities: Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline. Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions. Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes. Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management;
AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction;
automated root-cause analysis;
and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone. Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection. Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers. Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria. Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny. Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level. Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions. Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE. Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy. Requirements: Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise: Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements. Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance). Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5). Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces. Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models. Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes). Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders. Willingness to travel as required.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities. Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations. Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities. Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Treasury & Banking Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships. Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements. Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities. Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solution Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B) WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM? You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. WHAT YOU'VE ACCOMPLISHED... SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders. HOW YOU'LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Head Of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Finance- Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities. Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations. Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities. Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Treasury & Banking Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships. Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements. Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities. Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Application Process: Step 1: Submit Application Current CV/resume Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted) Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours. Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand. Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns. Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered. Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

Confira esta oportunidade para Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre a posição no jogo Estamos em busca de pessoas Product Managers Sênior com forte visão de negócio e capacidade de execução para liderar a evolução de nossos produtos digitais. No GRUPO SBF, nossos PMs atuam na interseção entre estratégia, dados, tecnologia e experiência do usuário, transformando desafios complexos em soluções digitais escaláveis. Esta é uma banca de talentos estratégica para posições que impactam diretamente a eficiência operacional e a geração de valor do grupo. Buscamos profissionais que joguem em alto nível, que saibam navegar por ambientes ambíguos e que queiram liderar transformações reais no ecossistema do esporte. Objetivos estratégicos do produto Orientação a Resultados e Negócio: Conectar a estratégia do produto diretamente aos KPIs críticos do negócio, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e retorno sobre o investimento. Decisões Baseadas em Dados: Estabelecer uma cultura analítica forte, utilizando dados quantitativos e qualitativos para embasar o roadmap, priorizações e hipóteses. Inovação e Eficiência com IA: Explorar e integrar o uso de Inteligência Artificial e automações para otimizar processos internos, melhorar a experiência do usuário e acelerar o time-to-market. Alinhamento de Stakeholders: Traduzir necessidades de diversas áreas (comercial, operações, marketing, etc.) em produtos digitais funcionais, garantindo uma adoção real e sustentável pelas frentes de negócio. Responsabilidades Definir e desdobrar a visão, estratégia e o roadmap do produto, alinhando a tecnologia às necessidades de crescimento da companhia;
Conduzir processos deDiscovery contínuos com usuários, clientes e áreas de negócio não-digitais, transformando dores reais em soluções de software;
Atuar com forte viés analítico, definindo, monitorando e comunicando KPIs claros de produto e impacto no negócio;
Avaliar cenários de Build vs. Buy (desenvolvimento interno vs. contratação de fornecedores), considerando custos, prazos e escalabilidade;
Trabalhar em estreitacolaboração com times de Engenharia, Design, Dados e parceiros de sistemas corporativos (como SAP e plataformas de mercado);
Gerenciar o ciclo de vida do produto com metodologias ágeis, garantindo a qualidade das entregas e a melhoria contínua;
Liderar e influenciarstakeholders transversais de forma clara, estruturada e colaborativa, garantindo o alinhamento de prioridades complexas. Requisitos Obrigatórios Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, e-commerce, ecossistemas complexos ou produtos digitais de alta escala;
Forte capacidade analítica e de negócio, com histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e métricas financeiras/operacionais;
Vivência prática em processos de discovery profundos com stakeholders de diferentes perfis (técnicos e não-técnicos);
Experiência sólida nagestão, priorização e refinamento de roadmaps e backlogs usando metodologias ágeis;
Comunicação clara, articulada e excelente habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders. Diferenciais Desejáveis Experiência ou interesse prático na aplicação de soluções de IA (Inteligência Artificial), LLMs ou automações avançadas no dia a dia do produto;
Experiência com sistemas corporativos e integrações complexas (ex: ERPs como SAP, CRMs, ferramentas de Analytics);
Domínio de ferramentas analíticas (SQL, Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
Histórico em projetosde transformação digital ou reestruturação de produtos legados. O que define sucesso nessa posição Alta taxa de adoção e engajamento das soluções lançadas pelas áreas usuárias;
Impacto mensurável nos principais KPIs de negócio atrelados ao produto;
Capacidade deentrega consistente e redução do lead time entre a descoberta da dor e o valor entregue;
Sólido alinhamento e alto índice de confiança estabelecido com os principais stakeholders. Bora movimentar o esporte!!

title: Cqv Engineer
description:

title: Analista De Customer Success Junior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Customer Success Junior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Vaga: Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Júnior para ajudar nas rotinas de atendimento e suporte, com a possibilidade de participar de projetos de automação e análise de dados no dia a dia. Queremos uma pessoa proativa e organizada que será crucial na otimização da experiência dos nossos clientes, realizando o monitoramento de métricas de sucesso e na proposição de melhorias contínuas em nossos processos, sempre com foco em garantir a satisfação e o sucesso dos nossos clientes. Quem Somos: A B2Brazil é a principal plataforma de negócios B2B da América Latina. Nossa missão é auxiliar as Micro e Pequenas Empresas (MPEs) brasileiras a acessarem novos mercados nacionais e internacionais, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de seus negócios. Visamos nos tornar a principal plataforma de negócios entre o Brasil e o mundo, atuando de maneira inovadora, eficaz e com soluções acessíveis. Sobre a equipe O time de Customer Success cuida de toda a jornada dos nossos usuários na plataforma, do primeiro contato até o pós-venda, garantindo que eles extraiam a melhor experiência possível com nossas ferramentas e serviços. Estamos em um momento de transformação, migrando tarefas operacionais para fluxos automatizados e assistidos por Inteligência Artificial, o que permite ao time dedicar mais tempo a análises estratégicas e à experiência do cliente como um todo. Principais responsabilidades Acompanhar o autoatendimento, atender e dar suporte a clientes (compradores e vendedores) da plataforma através dos canais oficiais (chat, WhatsApp, e-mail) em casos de escalonamento para agente ao vivo. Auxiliar na validação de documentos e processos de verificação de contas comerciais Gerenciamento de perfis, produtos, negociações e demais informações disponibilizadas na plataforma Acompanhar processos de onboarding e ongoing, revisando e contribuindo para a melhoria da experiência do usuário com a plataforma Contribuir para a manutenção e atualização da base de conhecimento utilizada por clientes e pelos agentes de atendimento (incluindo o agente de IA da empresa) Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de automação nos processos de atendimento Apoiar campanhas e iniciativas de comunicação com clientes, incluindo conteúdos multilíngues (português, inglês e espanhol) Monitorar indicadores de qualidade e satisfação do atendimento (NPS, CSAT, tempo de resposta, taxa de resolução) Colaborar com outras áreas (Marketing, Comercial) para resolver demandas e melhorar a experiência do cliente Requisitos Ensino superior completo em Administração, Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Marketing ou áreas correlatas Experiência prévia (estágio ou efetivo) em Customer Success/Experience, atendimento ao cliente, suporte ou áreas correlatas Inglês intermediário/avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação) Espanhol intermediário é um diferencial Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto Pacote Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) em nível intermediário Skills desejadas Boa comunicação escrita e verbal Inglês fluente ou avançado para comunicação profissional (escrita e conversação) Organização e atenção a detalhes Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas Facilidade para lidar com ferramentas digitais e novas tecnologias Interesse por automação, IA aplicada a atendimento e análise de dados Perfil analítico e orientado a resolução de problemas Trabalho em equipe e colaboração multifuncional Habilidade de negociação e argumentação. Conhecimento básico de comércio exterior (Incoterms, RFQ, processos de importação/exportação) é um diferencial Detalhes da Vaga Regime de contratação: CLT (Efetivo) Nível: Júnior / Entry Level Salário: R$ 2.300,00 Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto (Home Office) Benefícios Horário de trabalho flexível com ingresso entre 08:00 e 10:00. Relacionamento direto e sem burocracia com todos os colaboradores e diretores da empresa. Vale-alimentação Plano de saúde Plano odontológico Gympass Day off no aniversário

title: Dgb Americas Training Manager South Latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Dgb Americas Training Manager South Latam em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty Location : Brazil Reporting to: Education Senior Manager Role Mission We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region. Key Responsibilities 1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories. Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital). Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities. Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution. Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities. Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience. 2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM. Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer. Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements. Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs. 3. Brand & Product Expertise Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge. Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation. Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals. 4. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets. Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints. Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines. 5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.). Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance. Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach. Requirements & Skills 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred). Strong understanding of LATAM markets Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders. Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers. Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. If you live in Brazil, are fluent in English and want to build a global HR operation from scratch, we're looking for you! About Downtown Engineers Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States. We're a remote-first team of 30+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy — and that's what we want to nourish with our Human Resources. About the Opportunity You will be Downtown's first HR hire, reporting directly to one of the founding partners, with the mission of building the People function from scratch. Our operation is distributed by design across Brazil, the US and India. We have doubled our team in 2026 (now 30+) and will keep growing at a fast pace, with a People strategic plan already approved by the founders. For the first 12 months, this role will mix orchestration and execution: you will coordinate specialized recruiting agencies in the US, Brazil and India;
manage payroll and benefits;
design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world. One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Interviews, trainings, sensitive career conversations and negotiations with American vendors will happen in English, every day. Compensation & Structure Full-time contractor (remote, based in Brazil) Fixed monthly compensation Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application What you'll do (major challenges for 2026) A. People Operations across 3 countries Map and stabilize payroll, benefits and employment flows in the US and India Work alongside a BPO in India on hires, payroll calendar, SLAs B. Training & Development Coordinate technical training programs across the US and India Design and coordinate a management development program that allows us to keep growing sustainably C. Recruiting (outsourced execution) Manage specialized recruiting agencies in search for technical positions Build scorecards with hiring managers and document the selection process, preparing the future internalization of recruiting (with new HR hire) Must-haves Fluent English (written and spoken) — a hard requirement. This is not English for occasional meetings: you will run interviews, facilitate trainings, handle sensitive conversations and negotiate with US search firms in English, daily 8-12 years of generalist HR experience Experience at coordinator-to-manager level Strong vendor management skills: BPOs, recruiting agencies, development consultancies Autonomy to operate without a ready-made structure and maturity to work directly with founders Availability to work across time zones: the India window falls in the Brazilian morning, and the US window in the afternoon Nice-to-haves Experience supporting internationally distributed teams Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction (AEC) industry Prior experience as a first HR hire or building a People function from scratch Selection Process 1. Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV 2. Screening: English and communication assessment (video)3. Technical challenge 4. Interviews with leadership 5. Offer Why join Downtown? Role with direct business impact Work directly with founders Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy High growth opportunity as the company scales PS: why Brazil? Our CEO is Brazilian and that's where most of our non-technical teams are based.

title: Arquiteto De Soluções - Ia Microsoft
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto De Soluções - Ia Microsoft em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas. O que Buscamos? Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding.
- Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada.
-Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes.
- Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência. Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints.
- Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry.
- Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval).
- Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry. Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional.
- Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos).
- Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente.
- Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros) Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service).
- Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI.
- Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos. Diferencial: Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
Familiaridadecom Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
Conhecimento de AzureFunctions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
Experiência com AzureAPI Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
Familiaridadecom conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
Conhecimento de AzureSQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
Experiência com AzureKubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
Familiaridadecom monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
Certificação PL-100 /PL-200 (Power Platform);
Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);
Modelo deatuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;
Contratação CLT O queoferecemos? Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
Auxílio creche;
Convênio com Farmácia;
Parcerias comUniversidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
Parceria de descontoscom Seguro Auto e Residência;
Gympass;
Seguro de Vida;
Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei no 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TDLR : Pocket FM is hiring remote freelance Brazilian Portuguese Voice Over Artists with professional home studios for long-term, serialized audio fiction. The role requires native fluency and the capacity to deliver 20 to 40 hours of recorded content monthly on a per-hour paid basis. Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese) About Pocket FM Pocket FM is the world's leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide. As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators. Role Overview As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series. This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration. title: Solution Architect

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders. HOW YOU’LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency. Required Language Proficiency Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases) The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage. Engagement Terms This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept. What We Offer Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development. Application Note This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

manage payroll and benefits;
design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world.One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Interviews, trainings, sensitive career conversations and negotiations with American vendors will happen in English, every day.Compensation & Structure- Full-time contractor (remote, based in Brazil)- Fixed monthly compensation- Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your applicationWhat you'll do (major challenges for 2026)A. People Operations across 3 countries- Map and stabilize payroll, benefits and employment flows in the US and India- Work alongside a BPO in India on hires, payroll calendar, SLAsB. Training & Development- Coordinate technical training programs across the US and India- Design and coordinate a management development program that allows us to keep growing sustainablyC. Recruiting (outsourced execution)- Manage specialized recruiting agencies in search for technical positions- Build scorecards with hiring managers and document the selection process, preparing the future internalization of recruiting (with new HR hire)Must-haves- Fluent English (written and spoken) — a hard requirement. Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV2. Screening: English and communication assessment (video)3. Technical challenge4. Interviews with leadership5. OfferWhy join Downtown?- Role with direct business impact- Work directly with founders- Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy- High growth opportunity as the company scalesPS: why Brazil? title: Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Manager – Activities About Us At HBX Group, we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow. Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success. Job Summary As a Contract Manager, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs. This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution, with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities. Job Responsibilities Supplier & Portfolio Management Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times. Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact. Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations. Contracting & Negotiation Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms. Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand. Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning. Performance Analysis & Reporting Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics, identifying trends and opportunities. Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance. Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge. Operational Excellence Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality. Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines. Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability). Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams). Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities. Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits. Required Skills Strong prioritization and time management, with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously. High level of analytical thinking, comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics. Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities. Excellent relationship management and communication skills. High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities. Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently. Required Tech Skills Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs). Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms. Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions. Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus. Qualifications & Experience 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles. Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred. Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams. Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management. At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency. Required Language Proficiency Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases) The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage. Engagement Terms This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept. What We Offer Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development. Application Note This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives. Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred. Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Why Join VelaFi? At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset, we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.
