title: Engenheiro De Ia Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Ia Sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção. Esta não é uma vaga de "treinar modelo" nem de "fazer prompt em chatbot". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: - Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.
- Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.
- Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.
- Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.
- Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.
- Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.Js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer Manutenção do core (40%)- Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática.
- Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.
- Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.
- Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).
- Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta "agent crashou em loop", "PR criado no repo errado", "deploy não promoveu") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%)- Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).
- Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.
- Manter o agent-authority.Md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).
- Criar/refatorar skills.
- Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)- Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).
- Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).
- Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.
- Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;
expandir cobertura).
- Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você Stack técnica — obrigatório - Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.Sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa.
- Node.Js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).
- Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.
- Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que "diga ao modelo o que não fazer" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está "alucinando" um PR que não criou. Experiência - 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.
- Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre "rodou no demo" e "rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano".
- Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer "reescrever do zero".
- Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios;
comunicação verbal podeser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade - Determinismo >
magia. Você prefere umaregex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.
- Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.
- Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. "Documentei em texto" não basta.
- Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais - Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.
- Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.
- Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs.
- Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks).
- Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.
- Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick).
- Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam. Benefícios - VR/VA – Flash Benefícios - Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde - Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco - Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life - Day Off de Aniversário - TotalPass - Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

description:

If you live in Brazil, are fluent in English and want to build a global HR operation from scratch, we're looking for you! About Downtown Engineers Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States. We're a remote-first team of 30+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy — and that's what we want to nourish with our Human Resources. About the Opportunity You will be Downtown's first HR hire, reporting directly to one of the founding partners, with the mission of building the People function from scratch. Our operation is distributed by design across Brazil, the US and India. We have doubled our team in 2026 (now 30+) and will keep growing at a fast pace, with a People strategic plan already approved by the founders. For the first 12 months, this role will mix orchestration and execution: you will coordinate specialized recruiting agencies in the US, Brazil and India;
manage payroll and benefits;
design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world. One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV 2. Screening: English and communication assessment (video)3. Technical challenge 4. Interviews with leadership 5. Offer Why join Downtown? Role with direct business impact Work directly with founders Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy High growth opportunity as the company scales PS: why Brazil? Our CEO is Brazilian and that's where most of our non-technical teams are based.

The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. description:

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency. Required Language Proficiency Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases) The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage. Engagement Terms This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept. What We Offer Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development. Application Note This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. contracting tools, or booking platforms.- Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.- Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.Qualifications & Experience- 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.- Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.- Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.- Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives. Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred. Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Why Join VelaFi? At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. title: Solution Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solution Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B) WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM? You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. WHAT YOU'VE ACCOMPLISHED... SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders. HOW YOU'LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

description:

Job Title: Spanish Speaking Support Engineer – Civil Engineering Domain

Location: Brazil Remote

Working Hours: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM EU Time (Approx. 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM Brazil Time)

Language Requirement: Fluent Spanish (Mandatory)

Department: Customer Support / Technical Services


Job Overview

We are seeking a Spanish Speaking Support Engineer with a strong background in Civil Engineering and hands-on experience in civil design, drafting, and technical support environments . The ideal candidate will leverage their engineering expertise to assist customers with troubleshooting, workflow optimization, software configuration, and best practices related to engineering design solutions.

This role requires excellent problem-solving skills, strong customer service orientation, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to Spanish-speaking customers across the EMEA region.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to civil engineering professionals, addressing software usage, drafting, design, and workflow-related inquiries.
  • Deliver accurate, professional, and culturally appropriate communication in Spanish.
  • Translate and interpret technical issues and solutions when necessary.
  • Understand customer business processes and engineering workflows to deliver relevant and effective resolutions.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot software, configuration, and workflow-related issues through remote support tools, ticketing systems, and virtual meetings.
  • Document, track, and manage customer cases, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution in accordance with SLA requirements.
  • Collaborate with Product Development, Quality Assurance, and Knowledge Management teams to resolve escalated issues.
  • Create and maintain knowledge base articles, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and other support documentation.
  • Assist customers with software setup, implementation, and configuration activities.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend product or process improvements to enhance customer satisfaction and support efficiency.


Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Fluent Spanish communication skills (written and verbal) – Mandatory.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline – Mandatory.
  • 4–6 years of experience in a Technical Support, Application Support, or Customer Support role.
  • Professional experience in Civil Engineering Design, Drafting, or Infrastructure Projects.
  • Strong understanding of customer support processes, troubleshooting methodologies, and issue resolution.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple customer cases simultaneously while meeting SLA requirements.
  • Experience supporting customers across international markets, preferably within EMEA regions.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior field engineering or site-based project experience.
  • Experience in customer-facing technical support or software support environments.
  • Strong knowledge of drafting and design tools, including:
  • AutoCAD
  • Civil 3D
  • MicroStation
  • Familiarity with TeamSite or similar content management/collaboration platforms.
  • Experience with engineering document management systems and SaaS-based applications.
  • Basic scripting, automation, or workflow customization knowledge.
  • Exposure to infrastructure, transportation, land development, or construction engineering projects.


Work Schedule

  • Must be available to work during EMEA business hours (approximately 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CET).
  • Flexibility may occasionally be required for cross-regional collaboration or critical customer support situations.

title: Head Of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Risk (Crypto) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.


We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience.

  • Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources
  • Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks

  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders, including Support, Compliance, and Product teams to resolve complex cases and improve procedures


What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • 2+ years of FinCrime experience
  • Familiarity with investigative methodologies evidenced by use of analytical tools (e.G., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • A willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends
  • Critical thinking skills
  • Impeccable attention to detail
  • The ability to multitask, prioritise, and work well under pressure


Nice to have

  • A degree in law or STEM subject

  • Fluency in other languages

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

The Finance team keeps Revolut moving with clarity and confidence. From accounting to strategic support, they work across the business to assess risk, guide decisions, and drive growth. Their insight shapes everything from daily operations to long-term plans and plays a key role in how we scale.

We're looking for a motivated Finance Services Manager to manage treasury account onboarding processes and financial portal accesses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

  • 3+ years of experience in financial services, ideally in treasury, onboarding, or payments
  • Experience in a reputable and high-growth bank or fintech
  • Knowledge of various financial instruments
  • Expertise in delivering change and continuous improvement
  • A good understanding of key treasury or finance functions
  • Experience in risk and control management


Nice to have

  • Knowledge of SQL, Excel, and/or Python with impressive data analysis skills
  • Solid relationship management, project management, and leadership skills



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.
  • Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.
  • Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.


Application Note

This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

- Dar suporte e informações pertinente às equipes de Relacionamento com objetivo de apoiar a implantação e sustentação do Cliente;
- Representar a empresa nas licitações quando convocados e em eventos de relacionamento;
- Atualizar diariamente CRM quanto as negociações e visitas comerciais;
- Participar ativamente de todos os treinamentos técnicos e comerciais ofertados pela empresa. REQUISITOS - Ensino Superior completo em Gestão Comercial, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
- Experiência navenda de benefícios corporativos e contato com o cliente RH;
- Necessário carro próprio. INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS - Local de trabalho: Salvador/ BA e entorno;
- Horário de trabalho: 08:30 às 18:18 de segunda à sexta-feira. BENEFÍCIOS Up Alimentação ou Up Refeição PPR (Programa de Participação nos Resultados) Auxílio home office Auxílio creche Saúde: assistência médica e odontológica Up GO: opção de adiantamento salarial com percentual limitado Vale presente Up no mês de aniversário O dia do seu aniversário é na sua casa Incentivo ao estudo de idiomas Wellhub (Gympass): sua jornada de saúde e bem-estar começa aqui! Home office todas às sextas-feiras Anywhere Office: uma semana / duas vezes por ano Clube Up: descontos em diversas plataformas (faculdades, escolas de idiomas, lazer e compras) VIVA BEM UP (EAP): Serviços de apoio e acolhimento psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, nutricional e suporte em situações sensíveis. PROMOVEMOS A DIVERSIDADE, EQUIDADE E INCLUSÃO Independente da sua raça, cor, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, etnia, origem ou deficiência. Vem ser um Upper!

title: Profissional De Atendimento Ao Cliente
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Profissional De Atendimento Ao Cliente em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da empresa: A VG Empreendimentos Digitais é uma empresa especializada em operações de resposta direta, focada no desenvolvimento, validação e escalabilidade de ofertas nos mercados de produtos digitais e exportação de nutracêuticos. Com uma abordagem orientada por dados e performance, integramos estratégia, tecnologia, mídia paga, criatividade e análise para construir operações de alto desempenho e impulsionar resultados consistentes. Atuamos nos mercados nacional e internacional, reunindo profissionais de diferentes especialidades em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado à execução. Nossa cultura valoriza inovação, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e excelência, incentivando a busca constante por soluções eficientes e crescimento sustentável. Descrição da vaga: O cargo de Profissional de Atendimento ao Cliente na SV Corporation envolve atender clientes de forma remota por diferentes canais, como telefone, chat e e-mail, garantindo respostas ágeis e claras. O atendimento será realizado em inglês, sendo essencial que o profissional seja fluente no idioma (bilingue), com excelente comunicação verbal e escrita. No dia a dia, a pessoa irá registrar solicitações, acompanhar demandas, resolver dúvidas e problemas e orientar clientes sobre produtos e serviços. Também será responsável por monitorar a satisfação dos clientes, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e compartilhar feedbacks relevantes com outras áreas. Este é um cargo em tempo integral, com atuação totalmente remota, exigindo organização, disciplina e boa gestão do tempo. Qualificações Fluência em inglês (bilingue), com excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, pois todo o atendimento aos clientes será realizado em inglês. Habilidades em atendimento ao cliente (Customer Service), com foco em oferecer uma experiência positiva e resolver demandas de forma eficiente. Experiência em Customer Support e Customer Satisfaction, incluindo acompanhamento de indicadores e ações para melhoria contínua da experiência do cliente. Excelente comunicação, com capacidade de adaptar a linguagem ao perfil de cada cliente e orientar de forma clara e empática. Habilidades analíticas para interpretar dados de atendimento, identificar padrões e propor soluções para reduzir a recorrência de problemas.

Responsibilities Weekly - Review customer invoicing - Review vendor bills and submit payments - Approve and submit payroll - Perform P&L scrubs - Review cash flow forecasts - Resolve collection issues - Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller Monthly - Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook - Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook - Perform source document filing spot checks - Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment - Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant - Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package - Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant - Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month - Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes - Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills - Review process and procedural documents Quarterly - Complete 941 reconciliations - Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval Annually - Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually - Review the chart of accounts - Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings - Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency - Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review New Client Implementation - Review the new client's current process and procedural documents - Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on - Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package - Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant Requirements 4+ years of accounting experience Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred) Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis) Fluent English (written and spoken) Accounting or Finance degree Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset. Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST Benefits Fully remote role with some flexibility included Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes Access to TGG University and learning resources Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included) Notes: This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day) Working Equipment to start is required PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave About TGG Accounting At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners' lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions. We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission. Our Core Values: Loyalty Integrity Strong Work Ethic Forward Thinking - Grow The Mindset Team Player / Caring / Selfless Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh Freedom & Accountability

title: Accounting Manager
description:

Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller. Responsibilities Weekly - Review customer invoicing - Review vendor bills and submit payments - Approve and submit payroll - Perform P&L scrubs - Review cash flow forecasts - Resolve collection issues - Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller Monthly - Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook - Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook - Perform source document filing spot checks - Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment - Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant - Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package - Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant - Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month - Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes - Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills - Review process and procedural documents Quarterly - Complete 941 reconciliations - Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval Annually - Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually - Review the chart of accounts - Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings - Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency - Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review New Client Implementation - Review the new client's current process and procedural documents - Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on - Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package - Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant Requirements 4+ years of accounting experience Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred) Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis) Fluent English (written and spoken) Accounting or Finance degree Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset. Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST Benefits Fully remote role with some flexibility included Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes Access to TGG University and learning resources Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included) Notes: This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day) Working Equipment to start is required PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave About TGG Accounting At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners' lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions. We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission. Our Core Values: Loyalty Integrity Strong Work Ethic Forward Thinking - Grow The Mindset Team Player / Caring / Selfless Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh Freedom & Accountability

title: Coordenador(A) De Monitoramento, Avaliação E Pesquisa
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(A) De Monitoramento, Avaliação E Pesquisa em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. ABOUT BOLDINBoldin is the financial confidence platform, an all-in-one planning tool that helps hundreds of thousands of households build, manage, and optimize their financial future. Every month, 20,000+ people create a free plan and thousands convert to paying subscribers. We are profitable, growing, and backed by a deep data asset: millions of planning sessions, roughly 2M conversational AI messages, and rich behavioral telemetry across the full customer lifecycle.We are building our first dedicated data science function, and this role will define how Boldin uses data science, and who does it, for years to come.THE OPPORTUNITYWe are hiring our first Lead Data Scientist to turn Boldin’s growing data into insights that shape what we build and how our customers plan their financial futures, and to build the team that carries that work forward. You will partner directly with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to drive decisions across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation through retention and expansion, and to productize data-driven features that deliver measurable value to customers.This is a foundational, player-coach hire. You will not inherit a playbook;
you will write one. Youwill start hands-on, defining our experimentation culture, establishing the metrics that matter, and proving that data science can move the needle at Boldin. As the function grows, you will hire, mentor, and manage a small team of data scientists, setting the technical bar and the standards they work to. If you thrive on ambiguity, love working backwards from business problems, and want to grow from senior individual contributor into the leader of a function, this role is for you.A note on scope: This role is designed to grow into a people-management position. You will begin as a hands-on senior contributor and take on direct reports as the function scales, so prior leadership experience is required.WHAT YOU’LL DO- Build and lead the data function. Set technical standards, establish ways of working, and, as the team grows, hire, onboard, mentor, and manage data scientists. Act as a player-coach: ship work yourself while raising the bar for everyone around you.- Own funnel analytics and optimization. Map the full customer journey, from first visit through paid conversion and long-term retention. Identify where people drop off, why, and what we can do about it. Define activation metrics and instrument experiments to move them.- Build and iterate on predictive models. Develop churn prediction, trial conversion scoring, and uplift models that power targeted interventions (email, in-app messaging, pricing offers). Measure what works through rigorous A/B testing.- Productize data science for customers. Partner with product to develop data-driven features, such as improved retirement score modeling, smart asset allocation recommendations, and personalized planning insights, that make our customers’ financial plans meaningfully better.- Establish experimentation rigor. Design and analyze A/B tests across product and marketing. Build frameworks so the broader team can run experiments confidently and interpret results correctly.- Define the metrics that matter. Work with leadership to establish the top-line KPIs that tell us whether we’re winning (customer lifetime value, activation rates, early churn, and more) and build dashboards that make them visible and actionable.- Advise on data enrichment. Identify external data sources (demographic, behavioral, financial) that could sharpen our models and improve targeting for acquisition and retention.WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FORRequired:- 6+ years in product-focused data science, ideally within a cross-functional product team- 1+ years of leadership experience. You have formally managed data scientists or analysts, or served as a tech lead, project lead, or mentor with clear ownership of others’ work and growth. You are ready to take on direct reports, and you want to.- Advanced SQL and Python proficiency (pandas, scikit-learn, or equivalent)- Hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests and experiments- Practical predictive modeling skills: classification, regression, model evaluation, and an emphasis on shipping models that drive decisions rather than optimizing for theoretical accuracy- Strong communication: you can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for PMs, engineers, and executives- Comfort with ambiguity. You define problems first, then solve them. You don’t wait for perfectly scoped tickets- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, mathematics, or similar) or equivalent experience- Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)Preferred:- Experience as a first or early data science hire who went on to grow and lead the function- Experience hiring, building, or formally managing a data team- Experience with modern data stack tools (BigQuery, dbt, Looker, or equivalents)- NLP or text mining experience (especially relevant for our conversational AI data)- Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, or similar)- Background in financial services, SaaS, or subscription businesses- Exposure to uplift modeling, causal inference, or marketing mix modelingWHAT WE OFFER- Flexible PTO and a team that values sustainable pace- Personal laptop- Health and wellness package- Budget for English lessons- The chance to build and lead a function from scratch, and to define how data science works at Boldin, and who does it- A mission that matters: helping people retire with confidence, not anxietyKindly submit your application and CV in English.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Executive Leadership Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives. Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred. Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Why Join VelaFi? At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset, we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series.
