At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Finance Services Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Services Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role The Finance team keeps Revolut moving with clarity and confidence. From accounting to strategic support, they work across the business to assess risk, guide decisions, and drive growth. Their insight shapes everything from daily operations to long-term plans and plays a key role in how we scale. We're looking for a motivated Finance Services Manager to manage treasury account onboarding processes and financial portal accesses. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Ensuring group treasury accounts are managed and maintained effectively Managing portal access so key stakeholders have the correct permissions to keep the business running smoothly Scaling operations by ensuring new entities are set up correctly and controlled from a group treasury and finance perspective Supporting Settlements, Trade, and Support teams where needed Building and maintaining relationships with vendors to ensure business continuity Implementing new tools and processes to improve overall team performance Enhancing controls and documentation of current trading and funding processes Managing risk and control metrics, such as KRIs, KPIs, and SLAs What you'll need 3+ years of experience in financial services, ideally in treasury, onboarding, or payments Experience in a reputable and high-growth bank or fintech Knowledge of various financial instruments Expertise in delivering change and continuous improvement A good understanding of key treasury or finance functions Experience in risk and control management Nice to have Knowledge of SQL, Excel, and/or Python with impressive data analysis skills Solid relationship management, project management, and leadership skills Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who We Are MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry. What the Platform Team Does at MAVI Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service. About the Role We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows. What You'll Do Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles. Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers, build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated. Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs. Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions. Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities. Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers. Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving. Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties. Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes. What We’re Looking For At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role. Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment. Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric. High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information. Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change. Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach. Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do. Why You Should Join Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine;
you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business. No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness. Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :) Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration. Equal Opportunity Statement At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Product Manager - Sênior
description:

Sobre a posição no jogo Estamos em busca de pessoas Product Managers Sênior com forte visão de negócio e capacidade de execução para liderar a evolução de nossos produtos digitais. No GRUPO SBF, nossos PMs atuam na interseção entre estratégia, dados, tecnologia e experiência do usuário, transformando desafios complexos em soluções digitais escaláveis. Esta é uma banca de talentos estratégica para posições que impactam diretamente a eficiência operacional e a geração de valor do grupo. Buscamos profissionais que joguem em alto nível, que saibam navegar por ambientes ambíguos e que queiram liderar transformações reais no ecossistema do esporte. Experiência com sistemas corporativos e integrações complexas (ex: ERPs como SAP, CRMs, ferramentas de Analytics);
Domínio de ferramentas analíticas (SQL, Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
Histórico em projetosde transformação digital ou reestruturação de produtos legados. O que define sucesso nessa posição Alta taxa de adoção e engajamento das soluções lançadas pelas áreas usuárias;
Impacto mensurável nos principais KPIs de negócio atrelados ao produto;
Capacidade deentrega consistente e redução do lead time entre a descoberta da dor e o valor entregue;
Sólido alinhamento e alto índice de confiança estabelecido com os principais stakeholders. Bora movimentar o esporte!!

title: Associate Product Analyst - Vmake · Brazil
description:

You'll help gather customer insights, test new features, research market trends, and support product decisions that shape the future of AI-powered video creation. Monitor trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and creator economy platforms. Conduct competitive research on AI video editing tools and summarize key findings. Collect and organize customer feedback from multiple sources, identifying recurring themes and user pain points. Support Product Managers in writing user stories, documenting product requirements, and maintaining product documentation. Participate in feature testing, bug reporting, and quality validation before releases. Help analyze product performance metrics and prepare reports for stakeholders. Collaborate with Product, Design, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to improve the overall user experience. Stay current on emerging AI technologies and creator economy trends. Who You Are 1–3 years of experience in Product, Business Analysis, Product Operations, Customer Experience, Digital Marketing, or a related field. title: Coordenador(A) De Monitoramento, Avaliação E Pesquisa
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(A) De Monitoramento, Avaliação E Pesquisa em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. ABOUT BOLDINBoldin is the financial confidence platform, an all-in-one planning tool that helps hundreds of thousands of households build, manage, and optimize their financial future. Every month, 20,000+ people create a free plan and thousands convert to paying subscribers. We are profitable, growing, and backed by a deep data asset: millions of planning sessions, roughly 2M conversational AI messages, and rich behavioral telemetry across the full customer lifecycle.We are building our first dedicated data science function, and this role will define how Boldin uses data science, and who does it, for years to come.THE OPPORTUNITYWe are hiring our first Lead Data Scientist to turn Boldin’s growing data into insights that shape what we build and how our customers plan their financial futures, and to build the team that carries that work forward. You will partner directly with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to drive decisions across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation through retention and expansion, and to productize data-driven features that deliver measurable value to customers.This is a foundational, player-coach hire. You will not inherit a playbook;
you will write one. Youwill start hands-on, defining our experimentation culture, establishing the metrics that matter, and proving that data science can move the needle at Boldin. As the function grows, you will hire, mentor, and manage a small team of data scientists, setting the technical bar and the standards they work to. If you thrive on ambiguity, love working backwards from business problems, and want to grow from senior individual contributor into the leader of a function, this role is for you.A note on scope: This role is designed to grow into a people-management position. You will begin as a hands-on senior contributor and take on direct reports as the function scales, so prior leadership experience is required.WHAT YOU’LL DO- Build and lead the data function. Set technical standards, establish ways of working, and, as the team grows, hire, onboard, mentor, and manage data scientists. Act as a player-coach: ship work yourself while raising the bar for everyone around you.- Own funnel analytics and optimization. Map the full customer journey, from first visit through paid conversion and long-term retention. Identify where people drop off, why, and what we can do about it. Define activation metrics and instrument experiments to move them.- Build and iterate on predictive models. Develop churn prediction, trial conversion scoring, and uplift models that power targeted interventions (email, in-app messaging, pricing offers). Measure what works through rigorous A/B testing.- Productize data science for customers. Partner with product to develop data-driven features, such as improved retirement score modeling, smart asset allocation recommendations, and personalized planning insights, that make our customers’ financial plans meaningfully better.- Establish experimentation rigor. Design and analyze A/B tests across product and marketing. Build frameworks so the broader team can run experiments confidently and interpret results correctly.- Define the metrics that matter. Work with leadership to establish the top-line KPIs that tell us whether we’re winning (customer lifetime value, activation rates, early churn, and more) and build dashboards that make them visible and actionable.- Advise on data enrichment. Identify external data sources (demographic, behavioral, financial) that could sharpen our models and improve targeting for acquisition and retention.WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FORRequired:- 6+ years in product-focused data science, ideally within a cross-functional product team- 1+ years of leadership experience. You have formally managed data scientists or analysts, or served as a tech lead, project lead, or mentor with clear ownership of others’ work and growth. You are ready to take on direct reports, and you want to.- Advanced SQL and Python proficiency (pandas, scikit-learn, or equivalent)- Hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests and experiments- Practical predictive modeling skills: classification, regression, model evaluation, and an emphasis on shipping models that drive decisions rather than optimizing for theoretical accuracy- Strong communication: you can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for PMs, engineers, and executives- Comfort with ambiguity. You define problems first, then solve them. You don’t wait for perfectly scoped tickets- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, mathematics, or similar) or equivalent experience- Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)Preferred:- Experience as a first or early data science hire who went on to grow and lead the function- Experience hiring, building, or formally managing a data team- Experience with modern data stack tools (BigQuery, dbt, Looker, or equivalents)- NLP or text mining experience (especially relevant for our conversational AI data)- Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, or similar)- Background in financial services, SaaS, or subscription businesses- Exposure to uplift modeling, causal inference, or marketing mix modelingWHAT WE OFFER- Flexible PTO and a team that values sustainable pace- Personal laptop- Health and wellness package- Budget for English lessons- The chance to build and lead a function from scratch, and to define how data science works at Boldin, and who does it- A mission that matters: helping people retire with confidence, not anxietyKindly submit your application and CV in English.

Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese) About Pocket FM Pocket FM is the world's leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide. As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators. Role Overview As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series. This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration. Requirements Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese. Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles. Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting. Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet. Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules. Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions. Nice to Have Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management Experience working remotely with production teams Engagement Details Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor Location: Remote (Work from your own studio) Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis. How to Apply : Please fill in What happens after you apply? Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline: 1.Internal Evaluation: Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects. 2.Show Casting & Voice Testing: If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision. 3.Contract & Legal Alignment: Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms. 4.Calibration & Onboarding: Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow. 5.Production & Monthly Deliveries: Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

description:

You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a "nice-to-have";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the "waiting on us" side of any dependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We're Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role: We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do: Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve. What We're Looking For: 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Brand Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Brand Support Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Description: Customer Support Specialist Who We Are: Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform. Your Role: As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a "nice-to-have";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the "waiting on us" side of any dependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We're Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Accounting Analyst

Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice. MoveUp Media We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you! Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Brand Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Brand Support Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Description: Customer Support Specialist Who We Are: Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform. Your Role: As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a\ "nice-to-have\";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the\ "waiting on us\" side of anydependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We’re Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company's toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth. We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You'll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers. Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth Leading and executing core infrastructure projects Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms What you'll need At least a 2:1 degree from a top university 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones To enjoy working with data Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact An interest in the financial industry Nice to have Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R Compensation range Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly* Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly* Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process *Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Video Editor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


Location: Remote

Compensation: USD $20–30/hour

Type: Freelance contractor

Hours: Expecting 40–80 hours/month to start

Path: Potential to move into full-time within a few months


About trends.Ceo


trends.Ceo works with CEOs, executives, and senior leaders at high-trust firms.

Our work is not generic corporate video or random social clips. We help serious leaders turn their best ideas, experience, and perspective into sharp editorial video that feels credible, modern, and worth watching.

The work sits between documentary, executive communications, and premium social video. It requires strong storytelling, clean taste, and the ability to make complex business ideas feel clear and compelling.

We’re looking for a senior editor who can help us raise the creative standard.


The role


You’ll edit executive interviews and leadership content into polished short-form and mid-form videos for a business audience.

This role is for someone with strong creative direction and editorial sense. We need an editor who understands what footage to include, when to use it, how to shape pacing, where sound design matters, and how to make senior leaders look credible, natural, and engaging.


Responsibilities


Edit executive interviews into high-quality short-form and mid-form videos.

Find strong hooks, story arcs, insights, and human moments in raw footage.

Shape complex business topics into clear, compelling edits.

Make smart choices on b-roll, cutaways, pacing, music, sound design, captions, graphics, and text treatment.

Use AI tools where helpful to storyboard ideas, create simple animations, generate visual references, or support lightweight visual concepts.

Maintain a premium, modern, editorial visual style.

Work with our creative team to apply feedback quickly.

Stay organized, meet deadlines, and manage project files properly.


What we’re looking for


5+ years of professional video editing experience.

A strong portfolio with relevant interview, documentary, corporate, editorial, or premium social samples.

Excellent storytelling instincts.

Strong taste in pacing, structure, music, sound design, and visual polish.

Experience editing business, executive, documentary, or high-end interview content.

Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills.

After Effects and AI tools are a strong plus.

Comfort using AI tools as part of the creative process.

Strong English comprehension.

Reliable, organized, and comfortable working remotely.

What matters most


You can find the story inside the footage.

You know the difference between a generic clip and a strong idea.

You understand when to use b-roll, when to stay on the speaker, and when the edit needs breathing room.

You can make senior people look sharp without making the work feel overproduced.

You bring creative opinions, not just technical execution.

Application process


Please send:

Your portfolio or 3–5 relevant video samples.

A short note on your experience editing interviews or executive/business content.

Your hourly rate.

Your monthly availability.

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing test .

title: Consultor/Escritório Parceiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor/Escritório Parceiro em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT. É uma parceria.

O mercado está migrando da remuneração por produto para a consultoria fee-based. Cada vez mais consultores querem operar assim, mas esbarram na estrutura que isso exige: research, alocação, back-office, compliance, tecnologia e custódia rodando ao mesmo tempo.


A Nord abre sua rede de parceiros especializados para quem quer crescer sem carregar essa operação sozinho. Você mantém sua marca, sua autonomia e a relação direta com o cliente. A Nord assume a infraestrutura.


A proposta é estender a estrutura que sustenta a nossa própria operação de wealth em benefício do crescimento de operações parceiras.


Você cuida do que ninguém faz no seu lugar: o relacionamento e a proximidade com o cliente.


Para quem faz sentido:

Escritórios independentes buscando estrutura completa sem montar tudo do zero.


Se você já atende clientes e quer parar de carregar a operação sozinho, candidate-se. Nosso time entra em contato para uma conversa sem compromisso.

title: Perfusionista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Perfusionista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
  • Graduação completa na área de Saúde;
  • Pós-graduação em Perfusão ou Circulação Extracorpórea;
  • Microsoft Office básico a intermediário;
  • Experiência mínima de 03 anos na função;
  • Conhecimento de Anatomia Humana e Fisiologia do sistema cardíaco;
  • Disponibilidade integral e para viagens.

Diferencial:

  • Desejável CNH categoria B ativa;
  • Desejável possuir veículo (carro) próprio.
  • Participar da implantação de projetos de perfusão;
  • Realizar e validar testes de protótipos;
  • Realizar montagem de materiais descartáveis nos equipamentos de perfusão;
  • Operar máquinas de circulação extracorpórea (CEC), em cirurgias torácicas, cardíacas, de transplante de órgãos e de revascularização periférica, a fim de garantir a manutenção das atividades vitais dos organismos dos pacientes, durante a realização das cirurgias;
  • Operar equipamentos de Oxigenação por Membrana Extracorpórea (ECMO);
  • Controlar a manutenção da função cardiovascular e outras atividades vitais dos organismos dos pacientes (oxigenação do sangue, circulação sanguínea, temperatura corporal, pressão arterial, entre outros), durante os procedimentos;
  • Assegurar o funcionamento adequado dos equipamentos de perfusão, permitindo que os cirurgiões realizem as intervenções necessárias, com segurança;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos técnicos de qualidade e de segurança do trabalho;
  • Utilizar técnicas assépticas, para lidar adequadamente com o manuseio de materiais estéreis e biológicos;
  • Zelar pelo estado funcional (guarda, segurança e devolução) dos equipamentos da empresa;
  • Registrar informações dos procedimentos cirúrgicos realizados, em aplicativos/sistemas corporativos, para que as equipes de Assistência de Vendas e Faturamento, possam dar seguimento às etapas internas;
  • Apresentar Comunicados de uso de OPME (fichas de sala), devidamente preenchidos e assinados, para a equipe de Assistência de Vendas, conforme processo interno;
  • Registrar, junto a equipe de Qualidade, Não Conformidades ocorridas em procedimentos, como o mal funcionamento de equipamentos e dispositivos; atrasos, troca de tamanhos e/ou especificidades, etc., conforme processo interno;
  • Realizar a troca de dosímetros digitais e EPIs (quando pertinente), periodicamente e cumprir com as normas de utilização, conforme orientações da equipe de SESMT;
  • Preencher relatórios de controle e outros necessários, conforme solicitação da Gestão.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente administrativo (almoxarifado) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Almoxarife controla a movimentação de mercadorias em almoxarifado, recebendo, conferindo, armazenando e expedindo materiais, equipamentos e outros itens. Mantém registros da movimentação e emite relatórios informatizados de controle. Atua em consonância com procedimentos técnicos e com normas regulamentadoras de saúde e segurança no trabalho e de preservação ambiental.

Planeja leiaute e sinaliza áreas de risco do almoxarifado.
Realiza previsões de estoque dos itens do almoxarifado, dimensionando quantidades mínimas e máximas, controlando itens de alta e baixa rotatividade e fornecendo informações à área responsável por compras.
Cadastra produtos, seguindo regras de codificação e identificação do sistema.
Recebe mercadorias acabadas e semiacabadas no almoxarifado, confrontando notas fiscais com pedidos. Controla itens recebidos, conferindo quantidade, qualidade, vencimento e demais especificações. Lança a entrada de produtos no sistema.
Armazena produtos, organizando espaço físico, codificando e identificando itens. Agrupa produtos e ordena materiais de acordo com a rotatividade.
Prepara produtos para distribuição, separando por pedido. Reabastece o local. Lança a saída do produto no sistema. Pode acompanhar transporte do produto, informando à transportadora peso e cubagem e providenciando a distribuição do peso da carga de acordo com o limite legal de cada veículo.
Realiza inventário de bens e materiais. Controla estoques físico e contábil, utilizando métodos apropriados e sistemas informatizados. Emite relatórios informatizados de controle. Envia documentos fiscais para o setor contábil. Arquiva documentos.
Pode utilizar sistema informatizado de planejamento de necessidade de materiais.
Pode acessar o Sistema Integrado de Gestão Empresarial (Enterprise Resource Planning ERP), para consulta de informações atualizadas de outras áreas como compras e vendas , para controle das entradas e saídas de cada item do almoxarifado e para realização de inventários.
Realiza destinação de descartes de embalagens, seguindo procedimentos da empresa.
Zela pela boa conservação do almoxarifado e controla o acesso de pessoas.
Presta informações a auditorias internas e externas.

title: Assistente Administrativo
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente Administrativo em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Transformar vidas é o que nos move. Está pronto para fazer parte desse movimento?

Na Alpha Fitness, unimos excelência na gestão e conexão humana para proporcionar experiências que realmente fazem a diferença. Acreditamos que disciplina, responsabilidade e entusiasmo são essenciais para gerar impacto na vida das pessoas inclusive nos bastidores que mantêm toda a operação funcionando.

Buscamos profissionais organizados, proativos e apaixonados pelo que fazem, com espírito de servir, atenção aos detalhes e vontade constante de evoluir. Se você gosta de desafios, valoriza o trabalho em equipe e quer crescer em um ambiente que prioriza qualidade, eficiência e desenvolvimento, essa oportunidade é para você.

Objetivo do Cargo

Atuar com excelência técnica e comportamental nas rotinas administrativas, garantindo organização, suporte às áreas internas e eficiência dos processos. O profissional será referência em responsabilidade, proatividade e qualidade na execução das atividades administrativas e financeiras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Apoio Administrativo e Aprendizado em Equipe: aprender com a equipe de profissionais, contribuir na análise de dados e rotinas administrativas, auxiliando na compreensão de métricas e indicadores relacionados ao desempenho da área.
  • Eficiência e Colaboração: contribuir para o desenvolvimento de melhorias nos processos, com foco em aumentar a eficiência operacional e otimizar recursos, mantendo a qualidade do serviço.
  • Foco na Eficiência Operacional: Comprometimento e garantir a eficiência das opações do escritório, contribuindo e reforçando o espírito de servir;
  • Auxílio na Gestão Administrativa: Apoiar a gestão administrativa do escritório, auxiliando em tarefas, agendamento e organização das atividades;
  • Resiliência e Motivação: Demonstrar resiliência ao lidar com desafios administrativos e financeiros, mantendo o foco nos objetivos e resultados;
  • Conduta Ética e Responsável: Seguir os padrões éticos da profissão e da academia, representando um comportamento confiável e responsável das operações administrativas e financeiras.
  • Suporte Administrativo: prestar suporte na implantação de melhorias e otimização de rotinas, quando necessário, auxiliando no gerenciamento de documentos, controles, processos e relatórios.
  • Suporte Financeiro: Prestar suporte na implantação de estratégias simples para redução de custos e otimização de despesas, quando necessário,  auxiliando no gerenciamento de documentos, contas e relatórios;
  • Suporte as áreas da empresa: apoiar demandas administrativas das áreas da empresa (DP, RS, Financeiro, Comercial, Operacional e Atendimento ao Cliente), conforme necessidade.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior: Cursando Administração, Contabilidade, Recursos Humanos, Finanças, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Comunicação Clara e Concisa: Possuir habilidades de comunicação para transmitir confiança de maneira claras e precisa;
  • Determinação e Crescimento: Demonstrar determinação para aprender, adaptar-se e crescer profissionalmente, enfrentando desafios e mantendo-se motivado;
  • Pontualidade e Disciplina: Colaborar nos processos com compromisso dentro do prazo estabelecido e com responsabilidade;
  • Experiência: Comprovada em Pacote Office com ênfase em Excel

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Entusiasmo, proatividade e energia positiva;
  • Disciplina, senso de urgência e foco em metas;
  • Espírito de servir, empatia e escuta ativa;
  • Protagonismo, adaptabilidade e transparência;
  • Capacidade de multiplicar boas práticas no time.

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Boa comunicação e habilidade no atendimento ao público;
  • Capacidade de organização e controle de processos;
  • Proatividade para resolver problemas e otimizar rotinas;
  • Conhecimento básico em administração e rotinas de escritório, com foco em organização e controle de processos;
  • Conhecimento básico em finanças, auxiliando no acompanhamento de dados e rotinas financeiras;

Sobre a Alpha Fitness

Com mais de 30 anos de história, a Alpha Fitness evoluiu de uma academia de bairro para uma das maiores redes do Brasil, com mais de 750 colaboradores, 45 mil alunos e 26 unidades.

Mais do que números, nos destacamos por oferecer uma experiência acessível, acolhedora e focada na evolução real de cada aluno. Somos guiados por três pilares: excelência na entrega, performance humanizada e gestão inteligente.

Nossa cultura valoriza o cuidado com as pessoas, o protagonismo e a melhoria contínua.

Aqui, você não é apenas parte do time você faz parte de um movimento.

Alpha Fitness. Movimento que une.

Atua na prospecção ativa e no relacionamento inicial com os leads, buscando entender suas necessidades e apresentar os produtos ou serviços da empresa de forma a despertar o interesse.   • Contribuir para o alcance das metas de vendas e crescimento da empresa.
  • Realizar cold calls, cold emails, social selling e networking para captação de novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Gestão de pipeline de prospecção com base em dados utilizando de ferramenta de CRM (Pipedrive).
Requisitos:
  • Experiência prévia como SDR ou em prospecção ativa B2B;
  • Domínio dos processos de prospecção e qualificação de leads;
  • Experiência com CRM;
  • Comunicativo e dinâmico;
  • Conhecimento em SPIN Selling e BANT;
  • Facilidade com criação e utilização de scripts comerciais;
  • Boa capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico;
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer;
  • Autonomia para organizar sua rotina e tarefas;
  • Foco em performance baseada em números, voltado para atingimento
    de metas;

title: Coordenador Administrativo Financeiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador Administrativo Financeiro em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

MISSÃO DO CARGO
Responsável por assegurar a gestão eficiente e sustentável dos recursos financeiros e administrativos da organização de forma a equilibrar as necessidades operacionais com a saúde financeira da empresa.
DESCRIÇÃO DAS RESPONSABILIDADES
- Desenvolver e implementar estratégias financeiras para otimizar o desempenho econômico da empresa, inclundo a elaboração de orçamentos, análise de custos, previsão financeira e gestão de fluxo de caixa.

- Monitorar e controlar o orçamento da empresa, garantindo que os gastos estejam alinhados com os objetivos estratégicos, identificando áreas de eficiência e oportunidades de economia.

- Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento do planejamento estratégico da empresa, contribuindo com informações financeiras que possam influenciar as decisões estratégicas.

- Gerenciar o relacionamento da empresa com instituições financeiras, negociar empréstimos, se necessário, e garantir o cumprimento de obrigações financeiras.

- Assegurar a conservação dos bens da empresa , fazer intervenções e sempre que necessário aplicação de medidas corretivas a fim de garantir a eficácia na realização do objetivo.

- Assegurar que a empresa esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações fiscais e legais aplicáveis. Isso inclui a preparação e apresentação de relatórios fiscais e a gestão de auditorias.

- Supervisionar a equipe administrativa, financeira , Compras e de Recursos Humanos ,em todos os subsistemas da empresa fornecendo orientação e liderança

- Preparar relatórios gerenciais regulares para a alta administração, fornecendo informações financeiras e análises que sustentem a tomada de decisões estratégicas.

- Contribuir com implementação de processos e sistemas, que possam otimizar as atividades para obter resultados mais acertivos e com qualidade.

- Definir rotinas e estratégias para redução de custos.

- Elaborar plano de trabalho com informações suficientes para analisar com visão crítica e reconhecer os riscos , oportunidades do mercado, aproveitando os benefícios para organização.

- Identificar e avaliar riscos financeiros e implementar estratégias para mitigar esses riscos, garantindo a sustentabilidade financeira da empresa.
FORMAÇÃO/HABILIDADES ESPECIAIS/EXPERIÊNCIA
Formação: Superior Completo

Graduação Preferencial: Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia e afins

Desejável: Pós-gradução em Gestão Estratégica / Gestão Financeira / Gestão de Pessoas

Tecnologia: Nível avançado nas ferramentas de gestão interna
